simulation_model.note: Simulation model; base_len=1.2 includes wheel extent; chassis visual/collision box is 0.8 x 0.46 x 0.2 m.

derived_if_jetson_transform_and_costmap_.convention: X forward and Y left; conditional on the historical frames describing the same current mounting

limitations: Image configuration and launch references are not proof of physical current mounting or completed calibration.
Navigation footprint length 1.10 m and simulation model base_len 1.20 m are different models, not interchangeable measurements.
TEB actively uses a 0.80 m line model; its polygon model is commented out.
Jetson and simulation sensor offsets differ; do not mix them.
Jetson rslidar/base_footprint share Z=0 and base_link has +0.2 m, so Z=-0.2 is a coded frame relation, not measured LiDAR height above ground.
The backup Jetson file defines a different transform and is not the file loaded by the inspected Jetson launch.

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot xmlns:xacro="http://www.ros.org/wiki/xacro" name="robot">

    <xacro:property name = "base_len" value = "1.2"/>
    <xacro:property name = "base_wide" value = "0.66"/>
    <xacro:property name = "base_height" value = "0.2"/>
    <xacro:property name = "wheel_radius" value = "0.2"/>
    <xacro:property name = "wheel_thick" value = "0.1"/>

    <xacro:property name = "front_lidar_x" value = "0.4"/>
    <xacro:property name = "front_lidar_y" value = "0.3"/>
    <xacro:property name = "front_lidar_z" value = "0.6"/>

    <xacro:property name = "rear_lidar_x" value = "-0.4"/>
    <xacro:property name = "rear_lidar_y" value = "0.0"/>
    <xacro:property name = "rear_lidar_z" value = "0.3"/>

    <link name="body">
    </link>
    <joint name="body_to_lidarfoot_joint" type="fixed">
        <origin xyz="0 0 -${front_lidar_z}" rpy="0 0 0"/>
        <parent link="body"/>
        <child link="lidar_footprint"/>
    </joint>
    
    <!--lidar footprint-->
    <link name="lidar_footprint">

    </link>
    <joint name="lidar_footprint_link_joint" type="fixed">
        <origin xyz="-${front_lidar_x} -${front_lidar_y} 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
        <parent link="lidar_footprint"/>
        <child link="base_footprint"/>
    </joint>


    <!--base link-->
    <link name="base_footprint">

    </link>

    <joint name="base_link_joint" type="fixed">
        <origin xyz="0 0 ${wheel_radius}" rpy="0 0 0"/>
        <parent link="base_footprint"/>
        <child link="base_link"/>
    </joint>

    <link name="base_link">
        <visual>
            <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
            <geometry><!--can use mesh inf-->
                <box size="${base_len-wheel_radius*2} ${base_wide - wheel_thick*2} ${base_height}"/>
            </geometry>
            <material name="">
                <color rgba="1 0.4 0 1"/>
            </material>
        </visual>
        <inertial>
            <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
            <mass value="47.873" />
            <inertia
                ixx="0.774276574699151"
                ixy="-1.03781944357671E-10"
                ixz="0.00763014265820928"
                iyy="1.64933255189991"
                iyz="1.09578155845563E-12"
                izz="2.1239326987473" />
        </inertial>
        <collision>
            <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
            <geometry>
                <box size="${base_len-wheel_radius*2} ${base_wide-wheel_thick*2} ${base_height}"/>
            </geometry>
        </collision>
    </link>

    <!--sensor support link-->

    <!--lidar link-->
    <!-- use for rslidar16 -->
    <link name="lidar_link">
        <visual>
            <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
            <geometry>
                <cylinder length="0.1" radius="0.05"/>
            </geometry>
            <material name="">
                <color rgba="0 0 0 1"/>
            </material>
        </visual>
        <inertial>
            <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
            <mass value="1e-5" />
            <inertia ixx="1e-6" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="1e-6" iyz="0" izz="1e-6" />
        </inertial>
        <collision>
            <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
            <geometry>
                <cylinder length="0.1" radius="0.05"/>
            </geometry>
        </collision>
    </link>

    <joint name="lidar_link_joint" type="fixed">
        <origin xyz="${front_lidar_x} ${front_lidar_y} ${front_lidar_z}" rpy="0 0 0"/>
        <parent link="base_link"/>
        <child link="lidar_link"/>
    </joint>

    <!--camera link-->
    <link name="camera_link">
        <visual>
            <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
            <geometry><!--can use mesh inf-->
                <box size="0.05 0.15 0.05"/>
            </geometry>
            <material name="">
                <color rgba="0 0 0 1"/>
            </material>
        </visual>
        <inertial>
            <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
            <mass value="1e-5" />
            <inertia ixx="1e-6" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="1e-6" iyz="0" izz="1e-6" />
        </inertial>
        <collision>
            <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
            <geometry>
                <box size="0.05 0.1 0.05"/>
            </geometry>
        </collision>
    </link>

    <joint name="camera_link_joint" type="fixed">
        <origin xyz="${front_lidar_x} ${front_lidar_y} ${front_lidar_z-0.08}" rpy="0 0 0"/> 
        <parent link="base_link"/>
        <child link="camera_link"/>
    </joint>

    <!--define link-->
    <xacro:macro name="robot_wheel" params="prefix">
    <link name="${prefix}_link">
        <visual>
            <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="1.57 0 0"/>
            <geometry>
                <cylinder length="${wheel_thick}" radius="${wheel_radius}"/>
            </geometry>
            <material name="">
            <!--black wheel-->
                <color rgba="0 0 0 1"/> 
            </material>
        </visual>
        <inertial>
            <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
            <mass value="2.6578" />
            <inertia
                ixx="0.00856502765719703"
                ixy="1.5074118157338E-19"
                ixz="-4.78150098725052E-19"
                iyy="0.013670640432096"
                iyz="-2.68136447099727E-19"
                izz="0.00856502765719703" />
        </inertial>
        <collision>
            <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="1.57 0 0"/>
            <geometry>
                <cylinder length="${wheel_thick}" radius="${wheel_radius}"/>
            </geometry>
        </collision>
    </link>
    </xacro:macro>

    <xacro:robot_wheel prefix="front_left"/>
    <xacro:robot_wheel prefix="front_right"/>
    <xacro:robot_wheel prefix="rear_left"/>
    <xacro:robot_wheel prefix="rear_right"/>

    <!--define joint-->
    <xacro:macro name="wheel_joint" params="prefix origin wheel_type">
    <joint name="${prefix}_joint" type="${wheel_type}">
        <origin xyz="${origin}" rpy="0 0 0"/>
        <parent link="base_link"/>
        <child link="${prefix}_link"/>
        <axis xyz="0 1 0"/>
    </joint>
    </xacro:macro>

    <xacro:wheel_joint prefix="front_left" origin="${base_len*0.5-wheel_radius} ${base_wide*0.5 -wheel_thick *0.5} 0" wheel_type="fixed"/>
    <xacro:wheel_joint prefix="front_right" origin="${base_len*0.5-wheel_radius} ${-(base_wide*0.5 - wheel_thick *0.5)} 0" wheel_type="fixed"/>
    <xacro:wheel_joint prefix="rear_left" origin="${-(base_len*0.5)+wheel_radius} ${base_wide*0.5 - wheel_thick *0.5} 0" wheel_type="continuous"/>
    <xacro:wheel_joint prefix="rear_right" origin="${-(base_len*0.5)+wheel_radius} ${-(base_wide*0.5 - wheel_thick *0.5)} 0" wheel_type="continuous"/>

    <!--define actuator-->
    <xacro:macro name="base_transmission" params="prefix ">

    <transmission name="${prefix}_trans" type="SimpleTransmission">
        <type>transmission_interface/SimpleTransmission</type>
        <actuator name="${prefix}_motor">
            <hardwareInterface>hardware_interface/VelocityJointInterface</hardwareInterface>
            <mechanicalReduction>1</mechanicalReduction>
        </actuator>
        <joint name="${prefix}_joint">
            <hardwareInterface>hardware_interface/VelocityJointInterface</hardwareInterface>
        </joint>
    </transmission>

    </xacro:macro>

    <!--xacro:base_transmission prefix="front_left"/-->
    <!--xacro:base_transmission prefix="front_right"/-->
    <xacro:base_transmission prefix="rear_left"/>
    <xacro:base_transmission prefix="rear_right"/>

    <!--define driver-->
    <gazebo>
        <plugin name="gazebo_ros_control" filename="libgazebo_ros_control.so">
        <robotNamespace>/</robotNamespace>
        <controlPeriod>0.001</controlPeriod>
        <legacyModeNS>false</legacyModeNS>
        </plugin>
    </gazebo>

    <!--gazebo>
        <plugin name="differential_drive_controller" filename="libgazebo_ros_diff_drive.so">
            <alwaysOn>true</alwaysOn>
            <updateRate>20</updateRate>
            <legacyMode>false</legacyMode>
            <rightJoint>rear_right_joint</rightJoint>
            <leftJoint>rear_left_joint</leftJoint>
            <wheelSeparation>${base_wide}+${wheel_radius}*2</wheelSeparation>
            <wheelDiameter>${wheel_radius}*2</wheelDiameter>
            <commandTopic>cmd_vel</commandTopic>
            <odometryTopic>odom</odometryTopic>
            <odometryFrame>odom</odometryFrame>
            <robotBaseFrame>lidar_footprint</robotBaseFrame>
            <publishTf>false</publishTf>
            <publishWheelTF>false</publishWheelTF>
            <publishWheelJointState>true</publishWheelJointState>
            <publishOdomTF>true</publishOdomTF>
            <wheelAcceleration>1.5</wheelAcceleration>
            <wheelTorque>30</wheelTorque>
            <odometrySource>world</odometrySource>
            <rosDebugLevel>Debug</rosDebugLevel>
        </plugin>
    </gazebo-->

    <!--define fric-->
    <xacro:macro name="drive_wheel_friction" params="prefix ">
        <gazebo reference="${prefix}_link">
            <mu1 value="100.0"/>
            <mu2 value="100.0"/>
            <kp value="100000000.0" />
            <kd value="1.0" />
            <fdir1 value="1 0 0"/>
        </gazebo>
    </xacro:macro>

    <xacro:macro name="wheel_friction" params="prefix ">
        <gazebo reference="${prefix}_link">
            <mu1 value="0.005"/>
            <mu2 value="0.005"/>
            <kp value="100000000.0" />
            <kd value="1.0" />
            <fdir1 value="1 0 0"/>
        </gazebo>
    </xacro:macro>

    <xacro:wheel_friction prefix="front_left"/>
    <xacro:wheel_friction prefix="front_right"/>
    <xacro:drive_wheel_friction prefix="rear_left"/>
    <xacro:drive_wheel_friction prefix="rear_right"/>

    <!--define color use in gazebo-->
    <xacro:macro name="gazebo_material" params="ref color">
        <gazebo reference="${ref}">
            <material>Gazebo/${color}</material>
        </gazebo>
    </xacro:macro>

    <xacro:gazebo_material ref="base_link"         color="whilte" />
    <xacro:gazebo_material ref="front_left_link"  color="Black" />
    <xacro:gazebo_material ref="front_right_link"   color="Black" />
    <xacro:gazebo_material ref="rear_left_link" color="Black" />
    <xacro:gazebo_material ref="rear_right_link"  color="Black" />

    <!--load lidar-->
    <!-- only use for rslidar16 -->
    <xacro:include filename="$(find velodyne_description)/urdf/VLP-16.urdf.xacro"/>
    <xacro:VLP-16 parent="lidar_link" topic="/velodyne_points" organize_cloud="false" collision_range="0.2" min_range="0.2" max_range="20.0" noise="0.008" min_angle="-${0.75*M_PI}" max_angle="${0.75*M_PI}" gpu="true">
        <origin rpy="0 0 0 " xyz="0 0 0"/>
    </xacro:VLP-16>

    <!--load realsense-->
    <xacro:include filename="$(find realsense_ros_gazebo)/xacro/depthcam.xacro"/>

    <xacro:realsense_d435 sensor_name="realsense" parent_link="camera_link" rate="15">
        <origin rpy="0 0 0 " xyz="0 0 0"/>
    </xacro:realsense_d435>

    <!--imu for realsense-->
    <gazebo reference="camera_link">
        <gravity>true</gravity>

        <sensor name="imu_sensor" type="imu">
            <always_on>true</always_on>
            <update_rate>100</update_rate>
            <visualize>true</visualize>
            <topic>__default_topic__</topic>
            <plugin filename="libgazebo_ros_imu_sensor.so" name="imu_plugin">

                <bodyName>realsense_link</bodyName>
                <frameName>realsense_depth_optical_frame</frameName>
                <topicName>/realsense/imu</topicName>
                <serviceName>imu_service</serviceName>

                <updateRateHZ>100.0</updateRateHZ>
                <!-- <gaussianNoise>0.0</gaussianNoise> -->
                <xyzOffset>0 0 0</xyzOffset>     
                <rpyOffset>0 0 0</rpyOffset>            
   
                <imu>
                    <noise>
                    <type>gaussian</type>
                    <rate>
                        <mean>0.0</mean>
                        <stddev>2e-4</stddev>
                        <bias_mean>0.0000075</bias_mean>
                        <bias_stddev>0.0000008</bias_stddev>
                    </rate>
                    <accel>
                        <mean>0.0</mean>
                        <stddev>1.7e-2</stddev>
                        <bias_mean>0.01</bias_mean>
                        <bias_stddev>0.001</bias_stddev>
                    </accel>
                    <!-- <rate>
                        <mean>0.0</mean>
                        <stddev>0.1</stddev>
                        <bias_mean>0.0</bias_mean>
                        <bias_stddev>0.0</bias_stddev>
                    </rate>
                    <accel>
                        <mean>0.0</mean>
                        <stddev>0.1</stddev>
                        <bias_mean>0.01</bias_mean>
                        <bias_stddev>0.01</bias_stddev>
                    </accel> -->
                    </noise>
                </imu>
            </plugin>
            <pose>0 0 0 0 0 0</pose>
        </sensor>
    </gazebo>


</robot >

<launch>
  <!-- these are the arguments you can pass this launch file, for example paused:=true -->
  <arg name="paused" default="false"/>
  <arg name="use_sim_time" default="true"/>
  <arg name="gui" default="true"/>
  <arg name="headless" default="false"/>
  <arg name="debug" default="false"/>

  <!-- We resume the logic in empty_world.launch, changing only the name of the world to be launched -->
  <include file="$(find gazebo_ros)/launch/empty_world.launch"> 
    <arg name="world_name" value="$(find wheel_body)/world/hospital_dynamic/hospital_dynamic.world"/>
    <arg name="debug" value="$(arg debug)" />
    <arg name="gui" value="$(arg gui)" />
    <arg name="paused" value="$(arg paused)"/>
    <arg name="use_sim_time" value="$(arg use_sim_time)"/>
    <arg name="headless" value="$(arg headless)"/>
  </include>

  <!--pub robot state and joint state-->
  <node name="joint_state_publisher" pkg="joint_state_publisher" type="joint_state_publisher"/>
  <node name="robot_state_publisher" pkg="robot_state_publisher" type="robot_state_publisher"/>

  <!--model load-->
  <param name="robot_description" command="$(find xacro)/xacro --inorder '$(find wheel_body)/urdf/robot.urdf.xacro'" />
  <!-- <node pkg="gazebo_ros" type="spawn_model" name="spawn_robot" args="-urdf -param /robot_description -model robot"/> -->
  <node pkg="gazebo_ros" type="spawn_model" name="spawn_robot" args="-urdf -param /robot_description -model mobile_base"/>
  <!--controller load-->
  <rosparam command="load" file="$(find wheel_body)/config/base_control.yaml" />
  <node name="base_controller_spawner" pkg="controller_manager" type="spawner" args="robot_base_joint_publisher robot_base_velocity_controller"/>
    
  <!-- RViz -->
  <node name="wheel_rviz" pkg="rviz" type="rviz" args="-d $(find wheel_body)/rviz/wheel.rviz" required="true"/>

</launch>

local_costmap:
  global_frame: map #map
  robot_base_frame: base_link
  update_frequency: 4.0 
  publish_frequency: 4.0
  static_map: false # if using only static map
  rolling_window: true
  width: 7.0 #20.0
  height: 7.0 #20.0
  resolution: 0.1

  footprint: [[-0.28,-0.33],[0.82,-0.33],[0.82,0.33],[-0.28,0.33]]

  transform_tolerance: 1.0

  map_type: costmap

  obstacle_layer:
    max_obstacle_height: 0.8
    min_obstacle_height: 0.1
    enabled: true
    obstacle_range: 7.0 #25.0 # the range limit of 2d lasers
    raytrace_range: 7.0 #25.0
    track_unknown_space: false
    combination_method: 1

    observation_sources: laser_scan_sensor
    laser_scan_sensor: {
      data_type: LaserScan, 
      topic: /scan,
      clearing: true, 
      observation_persistence: 0.0,
      inf_is_valid: true
      }
# point_cloud2_sensor: {data_type: PointCloud2, topic: rslidar_points, max_obstacle_height: 2.8, min_obstacle_height: 0.2}

  inflation_layer:
    enabled:              true
    cost_scaling_factor:  10.0  # exponential rate at which the obstacle cost drops off (default: 10)
    inflation_radius:     0.1  # 0.1 #0.5 max. distance from an obstacle at which costs are incurred for planning paths.

  static_layer:
    enabled:              true
    map_topic:            "/map"

  plugins:
   - {name: static_layer,        type: "costmap_2d::StaticLayer"}
   - {name: obstacle_layer,      type: "costmap_2d::ObstacleLayer"}
   - {name: inflation_layer,     type: "costmap_2d::InflationLayer"}

TebLocalPlannerROS:

#  odom_topic: /kloam/mapping/odometry_fusion_baselink
# odom_topic: /roll/mapping/odometry_fusion_baselink 
 odom_topic: /hdl_odom
 # Trajectory
 teb_autosize: True
 dt_ref: 0.4
 dt_hysteresis: 0.08
 global_plan_overwrite_orientation: True
 max_global_plan_lookahead_dist: 5.0
 global_plan_viapoint_sep: 0.7 # 0.95
 feasibility_check_no_poses: 5
    
 # Robot         

# max_vel_x: 1
 max_vel_x: 0.8
 max_vel_x_backwards: 0.2 #0.5
 max_vel_theta: 0.32 # 1.08
# max_vel_theta: 1.08
# acc_lim_x: 0.9
 acc_lim_x: 0.24 # 0.2
# acc_lim_theta: 0.9
 acc_lim_theta: 0.24 # 0.2
 min_turning_radius: 1.12 # 1.05 # diff-drive robot (can turn on place!)

 footprint_model:
   type: "line"
   line_start: [0.0, 0]
   line_end: [0.80, 0]#
# footprint_model:
#     type: "polygon"
#     vertices: [[-0.28,-0.33],[0.82,-0.33],[0.82,0.33],[-0.28,0.33]]

 # GoalTolerance
 xy_goal_tolerance: 0.05
# 0.1 last used
 yaw_goal_tolerance: 0.04
# 0.05 last used
 free_goal_vel: False
    
 # Obstacles
 min_obstacle_dist: 0.29 # 0.1 # 0.29 # important,changing it to 0.1 will frequently display "trajectory not feasible"
 include_costmap_obstacles: True
 costmap_obstacles_behind_robot_dist: 1.0
 obstacle_poses_affected: 30

 # Optimization
 no_inner_iterations: 5
 no_outer_iterations: 4
 optimization_activate: True
 optimization_verbose: False
 penalty_epsilon: 0.2
 weight_max_vel_x: 2
 weight_max_vel_theta: 1
 weight_acc_lim_x: 2 #5 #1
 weight_acc_lim_theta: 1.5 #5 #1
 weight_kinematics_nh: 1000
 weight_kinematics_forward_drive: 1
 weight_kinematics_turning_radius: 1
 weight_optimaltime: 3
 weight_obstacle: 50
 weight_dynamic_obstacle: 10 # not in use yet

 # Homotopy Class Planner
 enable_homotopy_class_planning: False
 enable_multithreading: True
 simple_exploration: False
 max_number_classes: 2
 selection_cost_hysteresis: 1.0
 selection_obst_cost_scale: 1.0
 selection_alternative_time_cost: False
 
 roadmap_graph_no_samples: 15
 roadmap_graph_area_width: 5
 h_signature_prescaler: 0.5
 h_signature_threshold: 0.1
 obstacle_keypoint_offset: 0.1
 obstacle_heading_threshold: 0.45
 visualize_hc_graph: False
